Definition: from G473 and G378; to supplement:--fill up.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says he fills up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in his flesh for the church's sake. The word means to fill up what is lacking, to complete the measure.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for filling up what remains carries no system of its own; its mystery is Paul's, that his sufferings somehow complete what is lacking for the church.
